tools.name: check_price_increase
tools.description: AICTIONBOT™ price increase check by KULIC Advisory. Compares a supplier's requested price increase with the official Eurostat producer price index (goods) or services producer price index plus labour cost index (services) for Germany since the last price agreement. Returns market change, gap in perc

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists the categories the AICTIONBOT™ price increase check covers (Eurostat NACE codes for Germany), with German and English names.
